gateway.name: Gateway of India
gateway.hours: Open area, always accessible · best in daylight
gateway.tip: Come early morning to avoid crowds and touts. The plaza is a launch point for Elephanta boat tickets.

cst.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus
cst.price_text: Free to view from outside · station is a working railway hub
cst.tip: Photograph the Gothic facade from the street opposite. Inside, watch the crowds from a safe spot away from platforms.
cst.best: Late afternoon light on the facade

elephanta.name: Elephanta Caves
elephanta.price_text: Entry around INR 40 for Indians; foreigners pay more. Ferry ticket extra (check on the day)
elephanta.hours: Caves roughly 09:00–17:00 · closed Monday · ferries from Gateway area in the morning
elephanta.tip: Take an early ferry to beat heat and crowds. The island is a UNESCO site reached only by boat.

taj.name: Taj Mahal Palace Hotel
taj.price_text: Free to walk through public areas · drinks and meals priced separately
taj.hours: Lobby open to visitors; restaurants have their own hours
taj.tip: Dress smartly and have a drink or high tea to see the heritage interiors without booking a room.

marine.name: Marine Drive
marine.tip: Walk the curve at sunset when the 'Queen's Necklace' lights come on. Bring water; street food is nearby.

dhobi.name: Dhobi Ghat
dhobi.price_text: Free from the bridge · guided visits may charge a small fee
dhobi.tip: View from the road bridge; do not enter the washing area without a guide. Ask before taking close photos of workers.

chor.name: Chor Bazaar
chor.tip: Go with a local or guide. Bargain hard and keep valuables close in the narrow lanes.

mandai.name: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Mandai
mandai.price_text: Free to enter · pay for what you buy
mandai.tip: This is the old Crawford Market. Come early for produce and flowers, and watch your footing in the wet aisles.

slumdog.name: Slumdog Millionaire
slumdog.price_text: Film locations are not a ticketed site · tours priced separately (check on the day)
slumdog.hours: No fixed hours · locations are in Dharavi and other districts
slumdog.tip: The film was shot in several spots, not one attraction. If you want to visit Dharavi, book a responsible community-run tour.

snow.name: Snow Kingdom (Mumbai)
snow.price_text: Entry fee applies; check current price on the day
snow.hours: Check on the day · typically open daytime into evening
snow.tip: It is an indoor snow park with rented jackets. Good for families with kids; skip if you want real Mumbai sights.

colaba_causeway.name: Colaba Causeway street market
colaba_causeway.price_text: Free to browse · pay per item
colaba_causeway.tip: Good for clothes, jewellery and souvenirs. Start bargaining at about half the asking price.

cafe_leopold.name: Cafe Leopold
cafe_leopold.price_text: Meals roughly INR 400–900 per person (check on the day)
cafe_leopold.tip: A classic Colaba stop for drinks and snacks. Expect queues at peak dinner time.

bandra_promenade.name: Bandra Bandstand promenade
bandra_promenade.tip: Sea-facing walk past the Bandra fort area. Popular with locals at sunset; watch the tide.

juhu_beach.name: Juhu Beach
juhu_beach.hours: Always open · busiest in the evening
juhu_beach.tip: Try local street snacks from the stalls. Do not swim; the water is not clean.

haji_ali.name: Haji Ali Dargah
haji_ali.hours: Roughly 05:30–22:00 · check tide before walking the causeway
haji_ali.tip: The shrine sits on a causeway that floods at high tide. Cover your head and remove shoes before entering.

dharavi_tour.name: Dharavi community walking tour
dharavi_tour.price_text: Tours roughly INR 800–1,500 per person (check on the day)
dharavi_tour.tip: Book a non-profit or community-run tour. Ask before photographing people and businesses.

fort_walk.name: Fort district heritage walk
fort_walk.price_text: Self-guided free · guided walks priced separately
fort_walk.tip: Walk between CST, the High Court and the old Victorian buildings. Start early and carry water.

crawford_food.name: Mumbai street food walk (Fort area)
crawford_food.price_text: Pay per stall · roughly INR 300–600 to eat well (check on the day)
crawford_food.tip: Choose busy stalls with high turnover. Stick to freshly cooked hot food and bottled water.

malabar_hill.name: Malabar Hill viewpoint
malabar_hill.tip: Good skyline and sea views over the city. Combine with a walk in the nearby gardens.
